name: mri_fetal
description: Order a fetal MRI to supplement prenatal ultrasound for detailed evaluation of fetal brain, spine, chest, or abdomen when ultrasound findings are equivocal or abnormal.

region.description: Body region to image — the fetus in utero

contrast.description: Fetal MRI is performed without contrast (gadolinium contraindicated in pregnancy)

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., ventriculomegaly on US, suspected CNS anomaly, congenital diaphragmatic hernia)

when_to_use: fetal ventriculomegaly or suspected brain anomaly on ultrasound
suspected fetal spinal dysraphism or neural tube defect
congenital diaphragmatic hernia — fetal lung volume assessment
equivocal ultrasound findings requiring further characterization

examples.query: Anatomy scan showed bilateral ventriculomegaly, needs further evaluation

args.clinical_indication: bilateral fetal ventriculomegaly on ultrasound, brain MRI for further characterization
